explanations.trigger_explanation: Building on, altering, improving, moving, occupying, or otherwise affecting an authorized United States Army Corps of Engineers Civil Works project commonly triggers a Section 408 permission review.

known_unknowns: The same action may also require separate Section 404 or Section 10 authorization.
advisories: A pre-application meeting is commonly recommended before preparing a full Section 408 submittal.
notes: Confidence tier 1 because the requirement is directly described on official United States Army Corps of Engineers Section 408 materials.
